capture.provenance: Supervisor launched the owned original with --disable-quic, played music for about8seconds, paused and finalized its NetLog. Free account and playback context are supervisor observations.

recovery: Original URL request source -> stream-job dependency -> H2session/stream -> TLSsocket; pinned public hyperframe parses SSL_SOCKET_BYTES_SENT DATA, standard gzip decompresses; original embedded schema maps field numbers.
standardSubstitutions: Read-only standard hyperframe H2 DATA decoder and Python gzip decompressor; no native application function or response body is executed/read.
limits: Account/device/track identities, names, metadata values, headers and complete request payloads are not exported. Gzip/protobuf originals remain private mode0600 under ignored .local.
Boolean effective values include proto3 false defaults; wirePresent distinguishes absence from an explicit encoded value.
Identifier formats and equality are observed without publishing identifiers. Format does not establish an identifier generation algorithm.

Clock unit classifications compare private values with the original NetLog clock; duration units are interpretations of original field names and observed magnitude, not a clock-source implementation proof.
Advertised original capabilities and supported types are observations, not permission to advertise unimplemented features or Premium entitlements in the Dart app.
These observed state shapes do not prove Dart state construction, actual runtime policy, Dealer command acknowledgements, server permissions, or TLS/QUIC fingerprint parity.
